name: SevenRooms
oneLiner: Reservations, table management, guest CRM and marketing platform for restaurants and hospitality venues, owned by DoorDash since June 2025.
bestFor: Full-service restaurants, hotel F&B, nightlife and hospitality groups that want reservations, guest profiles and retention marketing in one system.

updates.text: Released AI features: AI Responses for review replies, AI Feedback Summary and AI Note Polish.
DoorDash completed its acquisition of SevenRooms (announced at about $1.2 billion); SevenRooms leadership stayed on to run the product.

Launched guest intelligence tools led by Voice AI (built on ElevenLabs), which answers calls, books reservations and recognizes returning guests, now with group cross-selling, payment collection and performance reporting.

features: Reservations and waitlist management with direct booking
AI table management: seating, pacing and cover forecasting
Guest CRM with profiles holding preferences, allergies, occasions and visit history
Automated marketing and segmentation by email and SMS
Voice AI that answers the phone and takes reservations
Review and feedback tools with AI reply drafting and feedback summaries
Secure payment collection for deposits and group bookings
Reservation channel partnerships such as TheFork in Europe, the UK and Australia

pricing.text: Custom pricing; SevenRooms does not publish prices.

notes: Acquired by DoorDash, closed June 13, 2025 (DoorDash 10-Q: $1,152M total consideration). Still sold under the SevenRooms brand. Dropped from current review: 'one of the fastest-growing hospitality CRM platforms' and 'backed by investors including L Catterton' (outdated after the acquisition). Online ordering and loyalty modules listed in the current review were not re-verified this session; left out of features. Customers from World's 50 Best partner page (also lists Marriott, MGM Resorts, Mandarin Oriental, Wynn, NoHo Hospitality, Black Sheep, Bloomin' Brands, Topgolf). Venue count conflicts (13,000+ in DoorDash release vs 16,000+ on older partner page); avoid citing. Voice AI '400,000 calls for 600+ restaurants' and 'up to 25% more reservations' are vendor-reported. A June 2026 'One Place to Manage Every Reservation' launch was seen only as a headline.
